name: Kurosaki Ichita
source:
The main character has a slightly cute face.

He is an ordinary boy, except that he likes his mom and older women, but he is somewhat spoiled and is always adored by the moms on both sides of the street.

Since long ago, when his mom would sometimes come home late from work at the school, he would often be treated to dinner at the neighbors' house, and they would let him stay there overnight.

Because they always took care of him, he also call them mom.

Thanks to his mother's education, her grades are good.

Her childhood friend Yuna confessed her feelings for him and they decided to go out together, but she is worried because he loves the moms so much.
